hēmĭcrānĭum ,
			ii, n., and hēmĭ-crānia ,
		ae, f., = ἡμικράνιον, 
I.a pain on one side of the head, headache, Cael. Aur. Tard. 1, 1, 4;
					Marc. Emp. 2;
					Ser. Samm. 2
			in lemm.;
			Plin. Val. 1. 8.—Deriv.
				hēmĭ-crānĭci ,
				ōrum, m., sufferers from headache, Theod.
				Prisc. 2, 1.
From A Latin Dictionary (Charlton T. Lewis, Charles Short, Oxford, Clarendon Press, 1879)
